description:
The ‘Ring of the Recorder’, which contains the records of sinners, has been stolen!?  The angel Eugene heads to ‘White Demon’, a pub in the human world where the culprit lives, in search of the ring. There, he meets the demon Ruth and strikes a deal with him: if Ruth grants him three wishes, he will return the ring.

*“Don’t you really remember me?”*

Ruth’s sad expression and his cryptic words leave him feeling uneasy...
